message.content:
Thinking about the PLSCR5 gene (Plasma membrane Steryl-binding Protein 5), this is a member of the PLSCR (Phospholipid/Sterol Carrier Receptor) family of proteins. Members of the PLSCR family are typically associated with the endoplasmic reticulum, where they function in lipid transport and binding. The PLSCR5 protein contains endoplasmic reticulum localization signals that direct it to this organelle.

[ANSWER]B[/ANSWER]
